mentions.name: Podcast Search Engine
mentions.description: A frontend to a semantic search system for finding podcasts, built with Elixir and Phoenix/LiveView as a tangent while exploring knowledgebase concepts.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I'm making a "Podcast Search Engine", partially as an excuse to play with Elixir and Phoenix/LiveView.

It's basically just a frontend to a semantic search system, and is a tangent while I explore "knowledgebase" concepts.
